title: Netlify Blocked the Account, Site Back in a Day | vitalii.no
description:
On 2026-09-26 a hosting provider blocked an entire account without warning, taking job.vitalii.no and its promo subdomain offline at once. There was no deploy path left, and the fix could not depend on any third-party platform's goodwill a second time.

The frontend now builds on every push to main via a GitHub Actions workflow, uploading a build artifact. A generic deploy script (parameterized so it is reusable across projects) pulls the newest artifact, unpacks it into a fresh release folder, flips a symlink, health-checks the result, and rolls back automatically if the check fails, marking the bad release so it is never served. A timer runs the script every 2 minutes; the site is served through its own web server behind the existing tunnel. The promo page moved out of manual uploads into the same repository, deployed by a plain sync step.

job.vitalii.no was back online within a day of the block with zero dependency left on the platform that caused it. Deploys now land automatically within 2 minutes of a push, and a failed deploy self-heals by rolling back instead of leaving the site down.
